harness: repo char-LM parity gate (memory-native-charlm): same architecture, corpus (tinyshakespeare, vocab 65), tokenizer, initialisation and token budget per arm (config=tiny: 4 layers, d=256, block 128, 4 heads; batch 32; 600 steps; eval 20)
caveats: 2 seeds only; the 0.03 val difference between counter_triton and the old torch path is within run-to-run spread for this budget and comes from a different stochastic-rounding stream, not from different math (same update kernel, same decode semantics)
peak VRAM is activation-dominated at this model size: the 4.8x persistent-state win does not translate into a large peak win
the fast path consumes no persistent fp32 weight and no AdamW moments; the per-step cost of the transient buffers is included in the measured peak
